confidence_aspects.title: Narrow bid-ask spread
confidence_aspects.description: A small gap between "bid" and "ask" orders means that traders are confident in the current probability. Currently the bid-ask spread is just 1 cent, the lowest it can be.

confidence_aspects.title: Good past performance on Survivor questions
confidence_aspects.description: Kalshi has 14 past markets about Survivor with a cumulative trade volume of $1,148,345. One month prior to resolution, those markets were on average 11% away from the actual resolution value.

confidence_aspects.title: Other prediction markets agree
confidence_aspects.description: Polymarket has their own market on this question with $34,125 in volume and an estimate within 5% of this one.

confidence_aspects.title: Expected to resolve soon
confidence_aspects.description: This market is scheduled to close in less than a week, which means traders can invest without locking up capital for a long time.

confidence_aspects.title: Price has been stable for 30 days
confidence_aspects.description: The price hasn't drifted more than 10% in the last month, even though the market has been liquid the entire time.

confidence_aspects.title: Good market depth
confidence_aspects.description: There are $14,323 of limit orders within 5% of the current price, which is very high for Kalshi and indicates high confidence. If you had insider information, you could wager $10,000 to win up to $104,365.

confidence_aspects.title: Kalshi return on investment
confidence_aspects.description: Kalshi offers 3.25% interest on held positions. On longer markets this would be expected to improve accuracy but this market will resolve soon so the point is moot.

confidence_aspects.title: Unambiguous resolution criteria
confidence_aspects.description: The resolution criteria is very clear and covers edge cases clearly. We should expect that the market's resolution will seem fair in hindsight.

confidence_aspects.title: Moderate liquidity rewards
confidence_aspects.description: Kalshi provides liquidity rewards for at least one contract within this question, with a pool of $300 for those with open orders. This is moderate for Kalshi.

confidence_aspects.title: Low recent trade volume
confidence_aspects.description: Trade volume in the last week is low compared to other points in this market's history. This could indicate that new information has yet to be priced into this market.

confidence_aspects.title: Low number of unique traders
confidence_aspects.description: The majority of trades on this market are from just 24 accounts. This is low for Kalshi and could indicate poor visibility.

confidence_aspects.title: Many new or unprofitable traders
confidence_aspects.description: There are 13 instances of new users betting large amounts on this market, which could affect the price significantly. Additionally, there are 2 instances of users with very poor past performance shifting this market by more than 3%. However, all of these have been corrected by other traders.

confidence_aspects.title: Potential misinformation in comments
confidence_aspects.description: Analysis of the comment section shows that some users may be attempting to manipulate the market through misinformation.

confidence_aspects.title: Inconsistent news coverage
confidence_aspects.description: Recent news articles seem to indicate that the probability may be more uncertain than this market indicates.
